atlas_layout: 4x4 grid of 24x24 tiles; tile with Wang index k is at column k%4, row k//4
wang_index: k = NW*8 + NE*4 + SW*2 + SE, where a corner is 1 if it is the UPPER terrain
notes: Water atlases have their floor pixels replaced with the wall atlas floor tile (tools/floorswap.py) so wall-atlas index 0 and water-atlas index 15 are the identical floor tile.
